_meta.purpose: Development-only generalization check for correction linking (plan-eng-review D4, D16, D18). Never tuned on, never held-out release evidence.
_meta.construction: Hand-written statement/correction/question triples that avoid the held-out generator's templates and the former correction cue words. Each history has 45 messages: neutral filler, the statement at position 10, the correction at 30, and a verbatim stale repeat of the statement at 35.

buckets.names_old_value: The correction names the value it replaces (gated: recall >= 0.80).
buckets.does_not_name_old_value: The correction never names the old value; a lexical system is expected to miss these (reported only).
